answer: A concrete sybil defense: reputation decays and must be continuously re-earned, so standing is a thread you weave every epoch, not a badge you mint once. An attacker's fresh clones shimmer at the horizon like mirages - each looks credible but carries zero accumulated work. Real weight only settles in accounts that persist and perform, the way jade polishes under steady hands. Since trust decays unless renewed, a sybil farm decays faster than it grows; volume of identities can never outlast the cost of maintaining them.
